# QuotaPulse — Global Antigravity Top-Up & Google AI Ultra Subscription Hub (12+ Markets)

> QuotaPulse (`https://vaxaxas.github.io`) is an independent third-party **Google Ultra top-up (`Antigravity代儲` / `Google Ultra 儲值` / `Google AI Ultra 課金代行` / `구글 AI 울트라 대리결제`)** and subscription activation service built for **Vibe Coders**, software engineers, solo founders, AI video creators, and researchers across Taiwan, Hong Kong & Macau, Mainland China, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, South Korea, India, the UK, EU, Latin America, Southeast Asia, US, Canada, and Australia. Activate dedicated individual **Google Ultra 5x ($69 USD/mo, reg. $99)** and **Google Ultra 20x ($138 USD/mo, reg. $199)** memberships directly on your own personal Google account — unlocking **Google Antigravity** (5-hour rolling multi-agent resets), **Gemini Deep Think**, **Google Flow & Veo** (10,000 to 25,000+ monthly video credits), **NotebookLM** (up to 5,000 daily queries), **20TB/30TB Google One cloud storage**, and **YouTube Premium individual perks** (per regional terms) with **ZERO password, ZERO 2FA, ZERO session cookies, and ZERO cross-region gift-card lockouts**. Backed by a 30/90/180-day pro-rata unused-day refund warranty for non-personal reasons (personal cancellations are non-refundable). QuotaPulse is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Google LLC.
